guidance: Manual host evaluation. Record actual tool schemas/events and committed state; structural tests do not establish native widget behavior. Leave not_run until observed.

cases.initialMaterial: A published quiz with saved prompt, rubric and private key. Run separate sessions with (a) a permitted async free-text tool, (b) only a Plan-only tool, (c) an async tool restricted to clarification, and (d) no question tool.
cases.startingPrompt: Quiz me using Codex's native question UI.
learnerActions: Inspect the current tool schemas and instructions before the first quiz
When permitted, answer a free-text-only asynchronous question
Otherwise observe explanation of the limitation before chat/file presentation
Exercise delivery without reply and then an explicit correlated reply
forbiddenShortcuts: Infer all native tools unavailable from request_user_input restrictions
Use a clarification-only tool for grading
Change mode or add a recommended correct option
Count delivery or default as a learner answer
Claim this verifies the historical session's tool inventory
requiredObservedEvidence: Actual session tool inventory and suitability decision before presentation
Preference respected when permitted; fallback explained before display otherwise
Only an explicit correlated response creates answer evidence
